assumptions: This binds the RECORD. It makes a domain change visible and forces re-discharge; it does not make any domain complete.
Nothing has been discharged against anything, so `proved_against` is null and the rule currently guards an empty set.
attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's fresh mediation issue against R7.3's own §12. That section refused an ABSENT universe, a DANGLING universe and a MERGED enforceability, and established nothing about the universe's CONTENTS: a legitimate future round could go from ten channels to nine, refresh its receipt, and the mediation gate would stay green — exactly the under-declaration failure a bounded universe is supposed to prevent, committed by the mechanism that introduced the bound. check-mosaic.mjs §12 now computes a sha256 over the canonical JSON of the bound object, carries it as `universe_binding.digest` with a `version_id`, and refuses a `proved_against` naming a digest that no longer matches. Registered mutations, executed with a positive control: DROP a channel, ADD a channel, and forge a `proved_against` against a stale digest. THE BINDING PATTERN IS NOT NEW HERE — it is MUT-HIST-REVISION-SWAP from R6.1, where a historical target had to bind the digest the NAMED REVISION'S OWN RECEIPT recorded rather than whatever the current file happens to say.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, on ROUND7_3_MOSAIC_BRIEF.md §2. Internally: R6.1's MUT-HIST-REVISION-SWAP, the same lesson at a different scope.

readjudicated.method: witness_reran_on_target — the named gate executes here and is green in this candidate's gate run
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: A digest binds WHICH rows, never WHETHER the rows exhaust anything. This makes a silent shrink impossible and leaves completeness exactly as open as it was.
attrs.statement: A mediation completeness claim must name the content digest of the domain it was discharged against, and a domain that changes orphans it.
